# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.

completion:
Determine the specific pollutants being emitted.
3. List down the regulated pollutants and their standards.
4. Compare the recorded emissions with the permissible limits.
5. Note the frequency and duration of emissions.
6. Document the date, time, and location of the excessive emissions.
7. Record the meteorological conditions at the time of emissions.
8. Provide a diagram or map showing the locality of the emission source.
9. Include any observations about the emission plume (e.g., color, opacity).
10. Detail the methods used for monitoring and measurement of emissions.
11. Calculate any exceedances of emission limits.
12. Provide photos or video evidence where possible.
13. Describe any visible impacts on the surrounding environment or community.
14. Mention any known or suspected malfunctions in emission control systems.
15. List any previous incidents of excessive emissions from the same source.
16. Summarize the overall compliance status of the facility.
